ruleDefinitions.name: ScreenSaver Registry Key Set
ruleDefinitions.description: Detects registry key established after masqueraded .scr file execution using Rundll32 through desk.cpl Note: Unmapped fields: Details

sequences.query: process_path = RGX("\\\\rundll32\\\.exe$") AND (registry_path = RGX(".*\\\\Control\\ Panel\\\\Desktop\\\\SCRNSAVE\\\.EXE.*") AND Details = RGX("\\\.scr$")) AND  NOT ((Details = RGX(".*C\\:\\\\Windows\\\\System32\\\\.*") OR Details = RGX(".*C\\:\\\\Windows\\\\SysWOW64\\\\.*")))
